_notes: D9 - Group piece-out distribution (catalog D9, plan test-plans/journey-d/d09-group-piece-out-distribution.md, runner row D9). dayOffset -12 is D9's own fixture day (Journey B owns 0...-9, C -10, D6 -11), inside maximumDaysForTransferExport = 21.

Three members are home-crewed, only participants punch in. numOfPieces=4 stays under maximumNumberOfPieces=5. Both participants share one crew time-in and one crew time-out, so their hours are identical and every split rule (by time worked, by head count, whole or fractional) gives 2 / 2.
expected.timeCards = 2 time-ins + 2 time-outs + 1 crew piece-out. crewEmployeeCell is the em dash the grid renders for a piece-out with no employee; pieceAmount = piecesPerCard x pieceRate.
Employee cells are asserted with toContainText(name), never exact text: they render from exportIdentifier, which is null for these pickers.
